name: pivot_implicit_group_by_bool_keys
query: SELECT account, number > 50 AS big, count(*) AS n WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:Food' PIVOT BY account, big
notes: PIVOT BY works with the implicit GROUP BY (no GROUP BY clause). The value columns are named with Python's str() of the key, so boolean keys give 'False' and 'True' (not 'FALSE'/'TRUE' like str(TRUE)), sorted False first.
